signing_settings.title: Company signing settings
signing_settings.intro: Staff fill in and sign the form, then its link reaches the tenant. The signing period starts when it is sent; the tenant is reminded at its midpoint and one day before it ends, and expiry without a signature is not consent.
signing_settings.empty: No company templates yet; copy a template from “Company templates” to set its period
signing_settings.threshold_label: Contract value above which Nafath is required ({{currency}})
signing_settings.threshold_hint: A contract whose total value exceeds this threshold is signed by the tenant only after identity verification through Nafath; below it Nafath is optional.
signing_settings.owner_only: This setting is managed by the company owner.
